prompts.title: 复古装饰艺术编辑肖像
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于创作一张高端复古风格的男性时尚肖像照。照片中，男子身穿剪裁考究的双排扣西装，置身于装饰艺术风格的玻璃彩绘大厅中。提示详细说明了相机型号（哈苏）、灯光（电影级对比度、彩色光）和构图（特写、四分之三侧身）。
prompts.content: Shot on a Hasselblad 907X 50C with an XCD 90mm f/2.5 lens, aperture f/2.8 shallow depth of field emphasizes the precision fit of the suit while the background dissolves into painterly color patches; captured in 16-bit RAW with high dynamic range and soft film grain to preserve wool texture and the glow of colored light without "harsh" digital sharpness. Frame a tight portrait cropped to mid-chest, at eye level, with a slight three-quarter turn; the model is offset from center so the stained-glass pattern reads in the negative space. The pose is calm and composed: shoulders open, posture confident but without tension; one hand neatly adjusts the tie knot or collar line, the other is in the trouser pocket, slightly opening the jacket and revealing the layered styling. Expression restrained and thoughtful; the gaze passes just past the lens, as if distant music is playing. Outfit a man in a suit with a retro accent: a structured double-breasted wool blazer with sharp lapels, high-waisted pleated trousers, a white shirt and narrow tie, polished Oxfords, and a minimal pocket square. Location a retro Art Deco hall with dark wood, brass, and a tall stained-glass window projecting jewel-like geometry onto the suit and background. Light warm practical fill from one side and colored stained-glass light from the other, cinematic contrast, "stained-glass" shadows. Result -retro editorial: graphic, refined, expensive, and timeless
prompts.translatedContent: 使用哈苏 907X 50C 相机和 XCD 90mm f/2.5 镜头拍摄，光圈 f/2.8 的浅景深突出了西装的精准剪裁，而背景则虚化成如画般的色块；以 16 位 RAW 格式捕捉，具有高动态范围和柔和的胶片颗粒感，以保留羊毛的质感和彩色光线的辉光，同时避免“刺眼”的数字锐度。构图为紧凑的半身肖像，裁剪至胸部中部，与视线齐平，略微呈四分之三侧身；模特偏离中心，以便彩色玻璃图案在负空间中呈现。姿势平静而沉着：肩膀舒展，姿态自信但不僵硬；一只手优雅地调整领带结或衣领线，另一只手插在裤袋里，略微敞开夹克，展现出叠穿的造型。表情克制而沉思；目光恰好掠过镜头，仿佛有遥远的音乐在播放。为男士搭配一套带有复古风格的西装：一件结构化的双排扣羊毛西装外套，带有锐利的翻领，高腰褶皱长裤，一件白衬衫和窄领带，擦亮的牛津鞋，以及一块简约的口袋方巾。拍摄地点是一个复古的装饰艺术风格大厅，配有深色木材、黄铜和一扇高大的彩色玻璃窗，将宝石般的几何图案投射到西装和背景上。一侧是温暖的实用补光，另一侧是彩色玻璃光线，营造出电影般的对比度，“彩色玻璃”般的阴影。效果——复古社论：图形化、精致、昂贵且永恒。

prompts.title: 90 年代复古防风夹克人像，带刺眼闪光灯（两个提示）
prompts.description: 以下是两个独立的提示，用于生成一位年轻女性肖像，她身穿色彩鲜艳的 90 年代复古风衣。两个提示都强调使用强烈、直射的闪光灯照明，以营造鲜明的投影效果，背景则装饰着拍立得照片和涂鸦。
prompts.content:
A close-up portrait of a young woman looking directly at the camera with a gentle, closed-mouth smile. She has dark, wavy shoulder-length hair and pale skin. She is wearing a bright retro 90s windbreaker zipped up, with blue, green, orange, and purple stripes and white drawstrings. The background is a beige wall adorned with taped polaroid pictures, colorful ticket stubs, and simple black marker doodles of hearts and a star. Shot with direct, harsh flash lighting that creates a hard black shadow behind her head and shoulders.

Prompt for Image 2 

A candid shot of a beautiful young woman standing at an angle, looking back toward the camera with a wide, toothy smile. Her hand is gently holding the collar of her brightly colored 90s retro windbreaker (blue, green, orange, purple). She has dark wavy hair and pale skin. The background is a beige wall with small polaroids, colorful flyers, and marker doodles of hearts and an '@' symbol. Harsh direct flash lighting creating a distinct, hard drop shadow on the wall to her right.

prompts.content: Use the uploaded image as the strict character reference. Preserve the character’s facial structure, expression, skin tone, hairstyle, outfit, proportions, and pose exactly as shown. Also keep background structure. Do not modify, beautify, stylize, or reinterpret the face in any way beyond embroidery translation. Render the character as hyper-detailed hand embroidery artwork, using realistic satin stitches, long-and-short stitches, and dense fill stitches to create natural depth, fabric texture, and thread sheen. Visible embroidery threads, precise stitch direction following facial contours, smooth gradients formed through thread layering, high stitch density, museum-quality textile craftsmanship. Neutral fabric background, soft studio lighting, ultra-sharp macro detail, photorealistic embroidery realism, no illustration or cartoon style.

One leg is crossed over the other casually. He's stirring a small white cup of coffee or espresso with a spoon in his right hand, while his left hand rests on his thigh. On the small round marble-topped table in front of him: a fresh flaky croissant on a white plate, a tall glass of orange juice, and a saucer under the coffee cup. The setting is a classic French sidewalk cafe with yellow woven bistro chairs, cobblestone pavement, and elegant Haussmann-style buildings in the blurred background under soft daylight. prompts.title: 现代厨房中双主体低角度电影感肖像
prompts.description: 一个复杂的 JSON 提示，用于生成一张低角度、电影感的肖像，其中包含两位截然不同的女性主体（一位像赛琳娜·戈麦斯，另一位是金发），置身于现代简约厨房中，重点关注特定的姿势、服装细节以及详细的灯光/反射完整性规则。

prompts.title: 高级时装新闻发布会抓拍照片提示
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于生成一张描绘主体被困在幽闭的“狗仔队围攻”中的高级时装社论照片，强调高对比度闪光灯照明、电影般的真实感，并严格保留主体的身份。
prompts.content: Transform the subject into a high-fashion press scrum photograph, surrounded tightly by cameras, microphones, and boom mics from all directions. Preserve the subject's face, features, and overall identity clearly recognizable. The subject is centered in the frame, partially obscured by overlapping microphones and camera lenses pointing inward, creating a sense of pressure and attention. Expression is calm, controlled, and unreadable - confident but distant. Styling is minimal and fashion-forward: dark clothing, sharp silhouette, sunglasses or statement eyewear optional. The image is shot like a real editorial photograph - direct flash, harsh highlights, deep shadows, and realistic textures on equipment. Colors are cool and neutral, dominated by black, grey, and metallic tones. The composition feels claustrophobic and symmetrical, with the subject visually trapped by media attention. Style: paparazzi press swarm, fashion editorial photography, cinematic realism, high-contrast flash, modern celebrity moment.
prompts.translatedContent: 将主体转化为一张高级时装新闻发布会抓拍照片，周围被来自四面八方的相机、麦克风和挑杆麦克风紧密包围。保留主体面部、特征和整体身份的清晰可辨性。主体位于画面中央，部分被重叠的、指向内部的麦克风和相机镜头遮挡，营造出一种压力和关注感。表情平静、克制、难以捉摸——自信而疏远。造型简约且时尚前卫：深色服装、利落的廓形，可选择佩戴太阳镜或个性眼镜。图像拍摄效果如同真实的时尚杂志照片——直射闪光灯、强烈的高光、深邃的阴影，以及设备上逼真的纹理。色彩冷峻中性，以黑色、灰色和金属色调为主。构图给人以幽闭恐惧感和对称感，主体被媒体的关注视觉上困住。风格：狗仔队新闻围堵、时尚杂志摄影、电影现实主义、高对比度闪光、现代名人时刻。
